title: Medical Records Request (Release of Information) — Terms on Fee Estimates, Fee Waivers and Refunds on Withdrawal
content:
These terms set out, for requesters of a Medical Records Request (Release of Information) at Riverbend Regional Health, the fee level at which a fee estimate is given, the waiver reasons Riverbend grants, and whether prepaid fees come back when a request is withdrawn before processing.

## Terms by request type

Column meanings:

- **Fee estimate threshold**: the expected fee at or above which the requester receives a fee estimate and confirms before processing.
- **Continuity-of-care copies carry no fee**: whether copies sent to another treating provider for continuing care carry no fee.
- **Waiver reasons granted**: the waiver reasons Riverbend grants.
- **Refund of prepaid fees on withdrawal**: whether prepaid fees are refunded when a request is withdrawn before processing.

| Request type | Fee estimate threshold | Continuity-of-care copies carry no fee | Waiver reasons granted | Refund of prepaid fees on withdrawal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | $25.00 | Yes | continuity of care; Social Security disability claim; approved Riverbend financial assistance | Yes |

## The waiver reasons, in full

1. **Continuity of care** — copies sent to another treating provider for the patient's continuing care.
2. **Social Security disability claim** — records for a Social Security disability claim.
3. **Approved Riverbend financial assistance** — a patient holding an approved Riverbend financial assistance award.

The list is closed at these three reasons on every request type.

## The estimate threshold at its boundary (hypothetical expected fees)

| Hypothetical expected fee | Compared with the $25.00 threshold | Fee estimate and the requester's confirmation before processing |
|---|---|---|
| $24.99 | below the threshold | the threshold is not reached |
| $25.00 | at the threshold | yes |
| $40.00 | above the threshold | yes |

An expected fee exactly equal to $25.00 reaches the threshold.
